_comment: This file is managed by the todo CLI. Do not edit it directly, by hand or with a script. Read it with todo: `todo next --json` (what to work on), `todo show --id <id|ref> --json` (one task), `todo list --flat` (every item as flat JSON records). Change it with todo commands (add, edit, move, status, assign, rm, ...; see `todo --help`), which keep its ids and rules valid.

tasks.title: Drag and drop widgets into and out of a Stack widget
tasks.description:
Bug: in the dashboard editor, widgets can't be dragged into or out of a Stack widget. Dragging an existing widget (e.g. Market) over a Stack doesn't drop it into the stack (the grid only shows the 12-column row placement), and a stack's children can't be dragged back out onto the row. Today children can only be added via the stack's own '+ Add' button.

[next-iteration 2026-11-27]
Readiness audit: info complete, complex. Files: DashboardRow.vue (own drag session: rowRegistry, hitRow only checks rows, emits move-widget), widgets/stack/Widget.vue (draggable group pull:false/put:false, children in config.widgets), move-widget handler in DashboardEditView.vue.
Decided: dragging out places the child at the guide column with width 6 (or the free span from firstFreeSpan); block the drop when fitsInRow fails, like rows do.
Decided: dropping into a stack inserts at the hovered index; the child's column is dropped (width is driven by the stack).
Decided: a stack cannot be dropped into a stack (no nesting), consistent with exclude=['stack'] in the stack's add dialog.

[next-iteration 2026-11-27]
Answer (breaking changes): "Allowed".
Decided: dragged-out child width = min(6, 12 - totalSpan(row)); block only when the row is full; the guide shows the shrunken span - matches cross-row move packing (insertByColumn + clampRowToLine) and addWidget shrinking.
Decided: the stack drop zone wins only while the pointer is over the stack card's body (children area); its header and surrounding gaps keep targeting the row guide.
Decided: a child dropped into a stack gets width = stack width and no column, mirroring addChild (stack/Widget.vue:56).
Note: row drag session is module-level in DashboardRow.vue and never mutates lists; needs a shared drag-session lib with stack drop zones and one atomic row<->stack update in DashboardEditView.

Decided: horizontal axis moves the container within the viewport (left -> margin-right:auto, right -> margin-left:auto, center -> both), matching the editor preview; drop the dead align-items. tasks.title: Dashboard setting: show an Edit button on the rendered dashboard
tasks.description:
New per-dashboard setting (off by default). When on, the rendered dashboard in the viewer shows an Edit button that opens this dashboard in the editor (/dashboards/<id>/edit), so entries can be changed from where you are looking at it. Needs: the setting in the dashboard model and settings view, the button in the viewer render (interactive dashboards only; not drawn on image/PNG output), and an editor URL that works when the viewer and editor are on different origins (HA add-on: viewer on host port, editor via ingress).

[next-iteration 2026-11-27]
Readiness audit: complex; deployment questions settled by an architect subagent. Files: internal/dashboard/types.go (ShowEditButton bool, omitempty - additive, carried by zip export/import), types/dashboard.ts, DashboardSettingsView.vue (General), app/cmd/config.go, app/router/handlers/info.go, app/router/main.go, app/router/middleware_static.go (browser.RenderData), internal/dashboard/browser/page.html, ha-addon/{run.sh,config.yaml,DOCS.md}.
Decided: editor URL comes only from explicit config - new server.editor.publicUrl (env DASHI_SERVER_EDITOR_PUBLICURL) + HA add-on option editor_public_url, validated with normalizeBaseURL; link = base + /dashboards/<PathEscape(id)>/edit. No derivation from request host: in the add-on the editor port 8099 is not host-mapped (dead link), and it would advertise the admin port on a public viewer.
Decided: no URL configured, or editor disabled -> button hidden. GET /api/v0/info exposes editor.url; the settings toggle stays usable and shows a hint to set server.editor.publicUrl / editor_public_url.
Decided: HA deep-link form <HA URL>/hassio/ingress/<slug> documented in ha-addon/DOCS.md; run.sh logs the hint with the real slug from Supervisor /addons/self/info (third-party repos prefix the slug).
Decided: small fixed bottom-right icon link with aria-label, low opacity until hover/focus, hidden in @media print, same tab (kiosks/tablets block pop-ups; back returns to the dashboard). Only in the browser render, and only for interactive dashboards (explicit dash.Type check - image dashboards viewed in a browser use the same renderer).
Decided: no extra gate beyond operator URL + per-dashboard toggle; DOCS warn to set publicUrl only when the editor is behind auth (auth.enabled defaults to false; HA ingress already is).
Needs you: verify on a live HA instance that subpaths under /hassio/ingress/<slug>/... are passed through to the ingress iframe (dashboards/<id>/edit deep link). Unverified - from memory only. If not, the docs should say the link opens the panel root.

[next-iteration 2026-11-27]
Answer (breaking changes): "Allowed".
Decided: ShowEditButton lives on Dashboard (next to ThemeID/ColorMode), not Container - viewer behaviour, not layout geometry.
Decided: toggle in the General section, shown only for interactive dashboards (v-if, like the image-only fields at DashboardSettingsView.vue:223); stored value kept on type change; server render also skips it for image dashboards.
Decided: normalize base URLs once in config loading (getAppCfg, app/cmd/config.go) for both server.viewer.publicUrl and server.editor.publicUrl, storing the normalized value; normalizeBaseURL moves out of handlers; invalid values dropped with a warning (keeps today's silent-drop behaviour for the viewer key).
